defect.evidence_quote: Once thé exigency had matured, of course, the officers were not bound to learn anything more or wait any longer before going in, even though their entry entailed some harm to the building.

reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use the disclosed wording exactly: "Once thé exigency had matured, of course, the officers were not bound to learn anything more or wait any longer before going in, even though their entry entailed some harm to the building."

defect.evidence_quote: when circumstances are exigent because a pusher may be near the point of putting his drugs beyond reach, it is imminent disposal, not travel time to the entrance, that governs when the police may reasonably enter;

defect.proposed_fix: Use the exact source fragment with lowercase opening and semicolon, or quote a larger fragment beginning with "That is,".

reasons: The opinion text supports the imminent-disposal proposition, but the reviewed quote is not an exact character match.
